notes.title: V1.0 [First ever collab version] + New Bundle official launch
notes.notes:
Long time no see, warriors, I'm the game's producer, Yuyuko.

It's been a long time, and this update brings you our【First ever collab 】version~

We are selling the updated version of our inter-dimensional collaboration with another excellent vampire-like game, Journey to the West Survivor, with a 25% discount on the bundle ~ for vampire-like gamers who love vampire-like games, play it all at once!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156731/8e065796152cd5e604cb9cb099307baffdd8ff79.jpg

The updates are listed below:

1、Added collab pet - Saitama Monk：
The signature character from [Journey to the West Survivor], "Monk Tang", has been added to [Hero of Fate] pets and can be unlocked by players with 1,000 gems.

Saitama Monk——”In order to obtain the True Scriptures, I have been honing my physical body, surpassing all the evil devils and foreigners in the flesh.“

The Physical Transcendence of "Real Work"

3、New Bundle Hero of Fate&Journey to the West Survivor

New bundle with 【Journey to the West Survivor】, the bundle includes 【Hero of Fate】 & 【Journey to the West Survivor】
Bundle discount: 25% off 

4、New Bundle Added - Heroes of Fate Complete Edition

Added the Heroes of Fate Complete Edition Bundle, which includes all Heroes of Fate DLC.
Bundle discount of 15% off

Finally, thanks again for your support.
